title: 37365 跟进：刷新或重开对话后，AI 回答下方的引用消失
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37365. The source is the os-dev report on PR #37485 (comment 7186618419, out-of-scope finding). The owning area files it under the source card, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 · reach: every user who reloads the console AI page or reopens a conversation, once cloud 10c produces citations · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：AI 回答下方的引用，刷新页面或重新打开对话后会消失。原因是恢复聊天记录时只保留了图表数据，没保留引用数据。让引用在恢复记录时一起恢复。
- 谁受益：使用应用内 AI 的用户。
- 不做会怎样：引用只在当场可见，刷新后就没了，无法回头查看出处。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
After PR #37485, the console draws chips from the `data-record-citations` part of a live message. History rebuilds keep only the chart data parts, so a persisted citations part is not drawn again after a reload. The rebuild paths are:
- `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` (the `/ai` history rebuild);
- the `useObjectChat` `initialMessages` rebuild;
- `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache` (`useChatConversation.ts`).

Keep the `data-record-citations` part (the persisted, already-verified list, ruling Q1) through each path, so that `extractRecordCitations` draws it after a reload. Re-verify nothing.

## Acceptance
- A test per path: a message carrying a valid citations part, rebuilt from history or cache, draws the same chips. A control with a refused part draws nothing.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Notes: no producer exists until cloud 10c lands, so do this before 10c ships, not after.
